 By Christian Allaire November 15, 2026 Photo: Getty Images Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story Tonight, the 2026 Governor Awards in Hollywood serve as the official kickoff to the 2027 awards season. (Yes, it starts this early!) Presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, the ceremony is being held at the Ray Dolby Ballroom, and will celebrate key figures in the film world—including special awards for actor Glenn Close, director Ridley Scott, and animator Floyd Norman, among others.
 Before all the accolades are handed out on stage, however, the Hollywood elite will hit the red carpet in their finest formal wear—choosing custom or fresh-off-the-runway gowns that are made for shining in the paparazzi flashbulbs. The annual red carpet affair, after all, is known to deliver plenty of glamour. Just see last year’s striking array of gowns and tailoring.
 You can certainly expect the stars in attendance tonight to start awards season with a bang. Don’t want to miss all of the glitzy fashion moments? Below, scroll on for all of the best looks from the 2026 Governor Awards. And be sure to vote on your very favorite look of the night.
